sources.text: Release record REL-2026-117: version 5.8 is proposed for production deployment on 2026-11-08; scope includes API gateway and customer billing workflow.
Verification summary: functional tests passed in staging; load test results are from version 5.7 and the security scan has one unresolved critical finding.
Change board note: operations owner is recorded; rollback rehearsal, security exception approval, and business owner acceptance are not attached.
